subject: CAIQ control retrofit: evidence snapshot & handoff plan
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control retrofit: evidence snapshot & handoff plan

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, attached is a concise crosswalk we drafted for the CAIQ controls you flagged around runtime telemetry, cache isolation, and log residency.

Quick summary of what we included:
- CAIQ mapping (sheet): control -> Redwood assertion -> evidence artifact reference (tabular).
- Runtime log snapshot: a 48-hour, redacted sample bundle showing request headers, KV cache hits/misses, and orchestration routing traces.
- Notes on tokenization and retention windows for tenants: where we enforce TTL and policy.

Action items we propose:
1) Redwood delivers redacted runtime logs (attachment) and an artifact index by EOD Fri (2027-07-02).
2) Nebula to confirm whether the 48-hour sample is sufficient for your audit window, or if you need a 7-day slice.
3) If you require on-prem proofing (longer retention or raw traces), we will schedule a secured session to walk through the live instrumentation.

Attachments: [Attachment: ca iq_crosswalk_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: runtime-log-snapshot.tar.gz (log bundle)]

If that timeline works I’ll loop in Engineering to kick off the extraction sprint.

Thanks,

— David Kim
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
"sales: +1 (415) 555-0124"

----
On Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:17 -0400, Emily Carter <emily.carter@nebulahealth.com> wrote:
> From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@nebulahealth.com>
> To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
> Cc: security_ops@nebulahealth.com
> Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:05:17 -0400
> Subject: Re: CAIQ control retrofit: evidence snapshot & handoff plan
>
> Hi David —
>
> Appreciate this. A couple clarifying items from Security Ops:
>
> 1) Residency: we need confirmation that the log snapshot contains no EEA-resident PII and that hostnames/IPs are redacted. Can you confirm the redaction process?
>
> 2) Sampling: for the SOC/CAIQ review we usually want evidence spanning the last 7 days. Is there a policy reason you picked 48 hours?
>
> 3) Delivery: our security team prefers SFTP for artifact intake (they won’t accept unprotected email attachments). Can you provide an SFTP endpoint or share via our secure Drive link?
>
> We’ll route this to procurement if we need any SLA carve-outs/contract language.
>
> Best,
> Emily
> Senior InfoSec Manager
> Nebula Health
>
> security_ops@nebulahealth.com

> - Marissa: generate artifact index and CAIQ crosswalk updates; push to shared Drive and produce a digest mapping to CAIQ questions. Target: Fri 2027-07-02 noon PT.
> - Rishi: perform a short validation run against the sample to confirm cache hit-rate evidence (KV cache traces) and produce a 1-page explainer. Target: Fri 2027-07-02 EOD.
>
> On the SFTP: we can do a short-lived, access-controlled SFTP drop for Nebula. Security will provision keys and we’ll share the endpoint once redaction completes.

> 2) Attached to the SFTP drop will be: ca iq_crosswalk_v2.xlsx (mapping), runtime-log-snapshot.tar.gz (redacted logs), redacted-telemetry-sample.json (JSON snippet), and a 1-page cache-hits explainer.
>
> 3) We’ll add a short note in the crosswalk about the specific CAIQ controls mapped to our cache isolation and KV store configuration (including the kernel/quantization note we discussed for inference engines).
>

>
